messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: aggregate 429/503 spike for eu-west-1 across /v1/generate and /v1/embed. Alert threshold 5% -> current 12%. Rolling 5m. Incident ID INC-2142.
Maya (Oncall): On it. Pulling dashboards now — which tenants are hottest?
ops-bot: Top offenders: tenant-psi (bursting), tenant-alpha (steady), and a stream of small tenants hitting new burst limit. Sample traces: https://dd.redwood/dashboards/INC-2142 (shortlink)
Jonas (SRE): I see sustained queuing on frontend pods + backend 503s around model A-large. KV cache misses high. Likely contention for GPU slots.
Felipe (Infra): Starting a fast check of Dedicated pools. If we can free a slot we might drop 503s quickly.
Maya (Oncall): Agreed. Immediate mitigations proposal: 1) Apply tenant-level ratepin (cap high-volume tenants to 40rps) 2) Disable realtime-synthesis feature flag for all non-SLAs 3) Route fallback requests to model A-small for any >1s queue. Anyone object?
Emma (PM-Search): Disabling realtime-synthesis will affect low-latency scoring for a handful of customers, but it's acceptable short-term. Notify Support.
Ryan (Support): Preparing a short template to message affected customers if we escalate.
Jonas (SRE): I'll apply a temporary per-tenant rate cap for tenant-psi and tenant-alpha. Command: 
```
# redwoodctl ratecap set --tenant tenant-psi --qps 40 --duration 30m --reason "INC-2142 live shape"
# redwoodctl ratecap set --tenant tenant-alpha --qps 30 --duration 30m --reason "INC-2142 live shape"
```
Maya (Oncall): Felipe can you flip the feature flag? Where's the flag path?
Felipe (Infra): Flag is `flags/realtime-synthesis/production`. I'll push a rollback-safe change to disable for `tier!=enterprise`. Patch: 
```
PATCH /flags/realtime-synthesis
{ "enabled_for": ["enterprise"] }
```
Rolling in 30s.
ops-bot: Action logged: rate caps applied to tenant-psi, tenant-alpha. Feature flag change queued.
Jonas (SRE): Routing rule update to prefer A-small for queued requests in eu-west-1 staged: 
```
# trafficctl route update --region eu-west-1 --if queue_len>3 --fallback model=A-small --priority=high
```
Maya (Oncall): Executed. Monitoring 429/503 panels. Link: https://dd.redwood/dashboards/429-503-eu-west-1
(1m) Maya (Oncall): baseline 429 rate 12% -> 7.3% after ratecaps applied.
(3m) Jonas (SRE): 429/503 trending down. 503s dropped from 140/min -> 28/min. 429s from 180/min -> 55/min. KV cache warmed slightly after traffic shift.
Emma (PM-Search): Any downstream effects on latency p50/p95?
Maya (Oncall): p50 stable, p95 improved for most routes. A-small increases cost/response time for long prompts but keeps tokens flowing.
Ryan (Support): Draft for customer note: 
"We're experiencing elevated throttling; we've applied temporary rate shaping and disabled a non-essential realtime feature to stabilize service. We'll follow up with timeline."
Felipe (Infra): Fine-grained telemetry shows tenant-psi still experiencing short bursts that hit qps cap. Consider increasing burst window not steady qps.
Jonas (SRE): I'll add a controlled burst allowance: 
```
redwoodctl ratecap update --tenant tenant-psi --burst 60 --qps 40 --duration 45m
```
Applying now.
ops-bot: ratecap update success for tenant-psi.
(12m) Maya (Oncall): 429% now down to 2.1% aggregate, 503 < 5/min. Dashboard panels: errors-by-tenant shows top contributor moved from tenant-psi -> now several small tenants.
Jonas (SRE): Nice. Marking current mitigation as successful pivot. Next steps: 1) Run quota backfill to reduce client retries 2) Add a longer-term autoscale profile for eu-west-1 model A-large 3) Postmortem and scope customer impact.
Emma (PM-Search): Please capture which customers lost realtime-synthesis and note degraded function in postmortem.
Maya (Oncall): I'll open INC-2142 ticket with timeline and mitigation steps. Tagging Support to send notice if we decide to notify customers whose latency/regressions exceed SLA thresholds.
Ryan (Support): Will hold draft. Ping me when final list is ready.
Felipe (Infra): For observability: I tweaked the dashboard to add a rolling quantile for queue_len and a model-slot utilization heatmap (deployed).
Jonas (SRE): Quick commands/notes for handoff: 
- Current mitigations: tenant qps caps (psi=40/alpha=30), burst windows (psi=60), realtime-synthesis disabled for non-enterprise, fallback routing to A-small.
- Health: 429 aggregate 2.1% (goal <3%), 503 <5/min (goal <10/min).
- Next checks: 2142012000 (approx 20m) for re-evaluation before scaling down mitigations.
Maya (Oncall): Okay I'll do the first re-eval and then handoff to morning oncall in 30m. Tagging @Jonas for infra follow-ups.
Jonas (SRE): Copy. I'll track GPU slot trends and autoscale metrics.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2142 updated: mitigations applied. Current status: stabilizing.
(36m) Maya (Oncall): Re-eval done — traffic stable. Starting graceful rollback: restore realtime-synthesis to `enabled_for: [enterprise, beta-partners]` and remove temporary burst allowances. Rolling changes with 5m canary windows.
Jonas (SRE): Confirming rollback won't reintroduce 503s; I'll keep routing fallback for another 10m.
(40m) ops-bot: Final status for INC-2142: mitigations removed, error rates within nominal. Incident will be moved to postmortem queue.
Maya (Oncall): Thanks team. I'll attach logs, dashboards, and the customer impact list to the postmortem. Closing thread. :heavy_check_mark:
